ft-fl-013.title: White cat takes the television
ft-fl-013.visual: The same white family cat jumps onto the broad top of an older deep television, lands, and tries to stabilize as it begins losing grip.
ft-fl-013.audioDescription: A white cat jumps onto the broad top of an older deep television and begins struggling for grip.

ft-fl-014.title: Physics has other plans
ft-fl-014.visual: Continue in the same room with the same white cat and same deep television: the cat slowly loses purchase, scrambles, slides off, bumps the nearby wall during the fall, and lands safely.
ft-fl-014.audioDescription: The same white cat slowly slides from the old television, scrambles, slips off, bumps the nearby wall, and lands safely.
